Delibird

Ice Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Delibird is an Ice/Flying-type Delivery Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 16 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (75), with a base stat total of 330.
